caption: The drawing displays five different views of a pocket watch. At the top center is the watch face, white with black Roman numerals marking the hours, smaller Arabic numerals marking each five-minute increment, and black minute and hour hands along with a blue second hand on a subdial at the 6 o'clock position. The watch face is encircled by a yellow-gold ring, and it is labeled "Columbus Watch Co., Columbus, Ohio." Below and to the left is an illustrated view of the watch mechanism, showing metallic gray and gold gears, a gold lever, and the inscription "Columbus Watch Co." on the mechanism's surface. To the right of the mechanism illustration is a depiction of the watch's back case, rendered in gold, featuring a raised design of a stag standing amidst floral and scroll patterns. At the bottom, two line drawings show the pocket watch from the front and from the side, each labeled "EXACT SIZE," with the side view indicating the thickness as a thin oval form and the front view as a circle with a winding crown. The overall composition is arranged on a beige or off-white background, with the colored illustrations at the top and the technical outlines at the bottom.
title: Gold Watch with Frame and Case
